paired_comparison_rule: For a fixed experiment and seed, every method uses the same dataset partition, preprocessing, training budget, and data-order seed.
hyperparameter_selection_rule: For each method, one learning rate is selected by mean best-validation Acc1 across seeds 0,1,2; the lower LR breaks exact ties. Each seed then uses its own best-validation checkpoint at that shared LR and evaluates test once.
test_selection_rule: The test split is not loaded during LR search and is never used to select LR or checkpoint.
